name: datacite-mcp-server
description: Search DataCite datasets and software, fetch DOI metadata, trace relations, format citations.

datacite_contact_email.title: DataCite contact email
datacite_contact_email.description: Optional. Your contact email, sent in the User-Agent (never a URL). Doubles DataCite's per-IP request allowance.

datacite_max_requests_per_5min.title: Requests per 5 minutes
datacite_max_requests_per_5min.description: Optional. Request budget per 5-minute window (50-1000). Default 800 with a contact email, 400 without.
